_comment: Night tuning. min_obviousness filters which clues spawn (3=only blatant, 1=subtle allowed).

shifts.name: Night 1
shifts.title: Training Shift
briefing: Register boots up at eleven. Customers come in until closing.
Scan what they put on the belt. Then look at them.
If something is wrong, refuse the sale. If nothing is wrong, let them pay.
Trust what you can see. Tonight should be simple.

shifts.name: Night 2
shifts.title: Something Is Wrong
briefing: More traffic tonight. I counted seven names on the book.
The lights have been doing something. Maintenance says they are fine.
Checkout anomalies count as evidence. Watch the register screen.

shifts.name: Night 3
shifts.title: They Are Learning
briefing: Some of them are copying human behaviour now. Badly, but trying.
Ask questions. Count the pauses. Watch the eyes, not the mouth.
Innocent people have strange habits too. Do not punish a tattoo.

shifts.name: Night 4
shifts.title: Unreliable Evidence
briefing: The camera monitor is working again. Some of them read differently on film.
Two clues at once, now. Sometimes three. None of them will be loud.
A wrong refusal costs you the customer's basket. A wrong approval costs more.

shifts.name: Night 5
shifts.title: The Final Shift
briefing: Nobody scheduled you for tonight. Your name is on the book anyway.
Three of them, maybe more. One of them is not like the others.
Finish the shift. Finish it clean.
